title: A muxed address reaches an account column in SEP-41 processing
severity_basis: A muxed address was stored un-reduced (one producer of issue #716); the claimable-balance and pool kinds stayed reachable until PR #756. Fixed upstream by PR #693 (6e5a5910); make lint-before-after shows the narrowing.

entries.observed: XDR102: xdr.ScAddress.String() renders M…, W…, B… and L… strkeys for the muxed, claimable-balance and pool kinds; it reaches account-key type types.AddressBytea at line 173 without being reduced to the base account (ToAccountId) or kind-checked

history.note: Created by xcc findings new from report row lint:github.com/stellar/wallet-backend@79ea2acd:XDR102:internal/services/sep41/events.go:extractAddressFromScVal.
Pre-fix side of a public upstream fix.

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record alone on 2026-11-12: 1 of 1 listed report rows failed again as recorded, all offline. Review: findings/review/F-0009.json.

evidence_added.reason: Fixed upstream; the fix itself is the evidence and the linter row is the pre-fix side of the before/after table.
